name: My AI Agents
tagline: AI agents analyze public lidar data to locate potential Maya archaeological sites
description: My AI Agents is a workflow that combines large language models such as Gemini, ChatGPT, Claude and Grok to examine publicly available NASA lidar data of the Maya region. The agents convert lidar strips into images, then 48 separate agents review each image for geometric features that resemble pyramids, platforms or plazas. They also search scientific literature, translate findings into Spanish, and draft reports for government agencies. The process requires no custom classifiers; the agents follow a detailed visual guide. The system is intended for archaeologists, researchers, and anyone interested in remote‑sensing based site discovery.
